paragraphs.source_en: After leaving Hamamatsu, Nobunaga reached the Imagire ferry. He was highly pleased by the splendidly decorated official boats and the new bridges specially erected over the Ōhira, Mutsutagawa, Yahagi, and other rivers; the ingeniously fashioned pontoon bridge across the great Tenryū River won still greater praise from him. The moment he returned to Azuchi, Nobunaga summoned Koretō Hyūga-no-kami Akechi Mitsuhide to the hall on the third floor of the extravagantly luxurious keep.
